MacroName wizard_tune

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_tune
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0.1
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 18.06.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

SuppressReports

Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard TUNING routine
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo

#################################################
# Read in optics config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile optics $repVal1\wizard_optics_config.txt
CallStringArray optics

#################################################
# User prompts
#################################################

IsVariableDefined type
If $repVal1 == 1
   If $type == 1
      EnterDefaultedNumber $TargetDefocus_tomo 1 At which defocus would you like to perform astigmatism/coma tuning? (typically -2 for SPA and -6 for tomography)
      defocus_tuning := $repVal1
   ElseIf $type == 2
      EnterDefaultedNumber $TargetDefocus_SPA 1 At which defocus would you like to perform astigmatism/coma tuning? (typically -2 for SPA and -6 for tomography)
      defocus_tuning := $repVal1
   Endif
Else
   If $EnableTomo == 0
      EnterDefaultedNumber -2 1 At which defocus would you like to perform astigmatism/coma tuning? (typically -2 for SPA and -6 for tomography)
      defocus_tuning := $repVal1
   ElseIf $EnableTomo == 1
      EnterDefaultedNumber -6 1 At which defocus would you like to perform astigmatism/coma tuning? (typically -2 for SPA and -6 for tomography)
      defocus_tuning := $repVal1
   Endif
Endif
Echo Astigmatism and coma-free alignment will be performed at $defocus_tuning um defocus (set by Z height).

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Which objective apeture size (in um) would you like to use? Choose' }
prompt1 = { 'No objective aperture to keep it retracted after coma tuning.' }
prompt2 = { '$ObjectiveAperture_1 um' }
prompt3 = { '$ObjectiveAperture_2 um' }
buttons = { 'No objective aperture' '$ObjectiveAperture_1 um' '$ObjectiveAperture_2 um' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   objap = 0
   Echo Objective aperture chosen to stay retracted after coma-free alignment.
   Echo
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   objap = $ObjectiveAperture_1
   Echo After coma-free alignment, $objap um objective aperture will be inserted and auto-stigmated.
   Echo
ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
   objap = $ObjectiveAperture_2
   Echo After coma-free alignment, $objap um objective aperture will be inserted and auto-stigmated.
   Echo
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

OKBox Please make sure that the autoloader turbo is set to 'Turbo Auto Off (default)'.

#################################################
# Set area for microscope tuning
#################################################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Do you want to do microcope tuning at the current stage position or move to the pre-defined sample area?' }
prompt1 = { '1: Current position' }
prompt2 = { '2: sample position marked in the Navigator' }
buttons = { '1: Current' '2: sample' }
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
If $repVal1 == 2
   MoveToNavItem $sample
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

SetColumnOrGunValve 1

# Refine are with view
V
YesNoBox Is the center of the current field of view suitable for astigmatism/coma tuning, i.e. gives sufficient Thon rings?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
Endif

# Reset image shift
GoToLowDoseArea R
ResetImageShift

# Retrieve Record mag
ReportMag
mag = $repVal1

# Retract objective aperture
ReportApertureSize 2
If $repVal1 != 0
   SetApertureSize 2 0
Endif

ScreenDown
Pause Center beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click Yes to continue
ScreenUp

# Set Z-height to have user defined defocus at eucentric focus
ReportAxisPosition F
dist = $repVal1
rot = $repVal2
SetAxisPosition F 0 0
YesNoBox Are you at or close to Eucentric height?
If $repVal1 == 1
   CallFunction ZwithG
   CallFunction ZwithG
ElseIf $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction ZwithV
   CallFunction ZwithG
   CallFunction ZwithG
Endif

# Stage settling afer Z-height adjustment
Delay 5 sec

# Auto-stigmate
CallFunction AutoFill
FixAstigmatismByCTF 0 1

# Coma-free alignment
CallFunction AutoFill
FixComaByCTF 0 1 0

# Insert and center objective aperture
If $objap != 0
   ScreenDown
   SetApertureSize 2 $objap
   SetCamLenIndex $Cam_length
   Delay 5 sec
   OKBox Please center objective aperture and click OK when done. \
   The objective aperture is already inserted and the microscope is in diffraction mode with the FluScreen is inserted.
   SetMag $mag
   GoToLowDoseArea V
   GoToLowDoseArea R
   Delay 3 sec
   Pause Center beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click Yes to continue
   ScreenUp
   Delay 5 sec
   CallFunction AutoFill
   FixAstigmatismByCTF 0 1
Endif

SetAxisPosition F $dist $rot

MakeVarPersistent defocus_tuning 0

#################################################
# Make variables persistent
#################################################

MakeVarPersistent objap

#################################################
# Closing message
#################################################

OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard TUNING routine. Astigmatism and coma-free alignment is completed.
Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Completed LowDoseWizard TUNING routine.
Echo Astigmatism and coma-free alignment is completed.
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo
